name: wan2.7-r2v
description: Wan2.7-R2V is a reference-guided video generation model that supports character, object, and scene references. With up to seven reference images, it generates new videos while maintaining consistent identity, style, and visual attributes. Supports 720P and 1080P, duration 2-10 seconds.
zhDescription: Wan2.7-R2V是参考引导的视频生成模型，支持角色、物体和场景参考。最多支持七张参考图片，生成保持身份、风格和视觉属性一致的新视频。支持720P和1080P，时长2-10秒。
longDescription: Wan2.7-R2V is a reference-guided video generation model that supports character, object, and scene references. With up to seven reference images, it generates new videos while maintaining consistent identity, style, and visual attributes. Supports 720P and 1080P, duration 2-10 seconds.
zhLongDescription: Wan2.7-R2V是参考引导的视频生成模型，支持角色、物体和场景参考。最多支持七张参考图片，生成保持身份、风格和视觉属性一致的新视频。支持720P和1080P，时长2-10秒。

modelParameters.label: Presence Penalty
modelParameters.description: 存在惩罚，鼓励模型讨论新话题

modelParameters.label: Top P
modelParameters.description: 核采样参数，控制候选词汇的范围

modelParameters.label: Max Tokens
modelParameters.description: 单次生成的最大 token 数量

modelParameters.label: Frequency Penalty
modelParameters.description: 频率惩罚，减少重复内容的生成

modelParameters.label: Context Length
modelParameters.description: 支持的最大上下文长度
